title: koeleria oreophila
intro: Koeleria oreophila, commonly known as alpine hair grass, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestive health due to its prebiotic properties. The therapeutic actions of Koeleria oreophila are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which may exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects. Further research is needed to confirm the extent of its health benefits and potential uses as a medicinal plant.
